items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So anyway, I was with Gene Coy, and he was coming back through Albuquerque.

ctx.x: Yeah. So I said... Boy, I got to tell you about that. We played a dance... After I got with the band, we were playing a dance out in Lubbock, Texas. And so some White guy walks up to the band, and it said, "Gene Coy and His Black Aces." He looked up at it, and we had some dark fellows in the band, so the guy says, "Yup, they're plenty dark all right" -- they're plenty Black all right; that's what he really meant. So anyway, I mean, I laughed; I shouldn't have laughed, I guess. And all the guys turned around and…

So anyway, I was with Gene Coy, and he was coming back through Albuquerque. But Gene Coy didn't pay nobody, you know what I mean? Like, we'd go play and play and play and play and play, and man, he'd wind up probably giving you two dollars or something. I said, "Gee, man, this ain't it."
